text:
maria (finance): Heads-up — saw an unexpected "accelerator premium" line on the Mar invoice for project Redwood-prod (us-west1). It's ~18% of the total GPU spend. Anyone else seeing this?
aj (infra-op): Which invoice line id? can you paste the raw line?
maria (finance): Sure — excerpt below from CSV export:
```
line_item_id,description,amount,unit_price,currency,region
LI-0987654321,Accelerator premium surcharge - NVIDIA A100,3240.00,1.18,USD,us-west1
```
maria (finance): Billed on top of the regular GPU hours line. looks like a multiplier not a separate resource charge.
sahil (eng-ml): Huh — that's not a GCP standard field we use. can you run the billing export query to see aggregation by sku? try this quick BQ: 
```sql
SELECT sku.description, SUM(cost) as cost, ANY_VALUE(line_item_id) as sample_li
FROM `billing_export.gcp`
WHERE invoice_month = '2026-03' AND project.id = 'redwood-prod'
GROUP BY sku.description
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
aj (infra-op): I pulled the raw invoice and matched LI-0987654321 to a reservation adjustment entry. Looks like some reservation credits were applied, but the invoice also shows a "premium" multiplier on time-based usage.
linda (cloud-ops): Possible cause: provider applied both committed use discount and a regional accelerator premium for the same hours due to billing classification mismatch. I've seen a bug where reservation adjustments and per-second SKU surcharges stack.
rachel (finance-manager): estimate impact? need to know if this affects committed capacity pricing for Q2.
maria (finance): Total premium line = $3,240. If it's duplicated across multiple projects we could be seeing ~12k.
aj (infra-op): Quick check: a handful of nodes were created by a legacy project id (redwood-ml-legacy) but charged under the same billing account. if those nodes used reserved capacity tied to redwood-prod, that could explain a double application. I'm verifying project IDs against the instance ids now.
sahil (eng-ml): Also check whether qps/usage spikes caused transient SKU upgrade to high-memory flavor; sometimes SKU mapping flips and shows up as "accelerator premium" in invoice UI even though underlying resource is same.
linda (cloud-ops): I'll open a support ticket with GCP and attach invoice lines + BQ export. draft message: 
"Customer sees accelerator premium applied on top of reservation adjustment for LI-0987654321; suspected double-application of reservation credit and regional premium. Please advise."
aj (infra-op): Created a quick audit query to map instance.zone + reservation_id to line item ids. will paste results in thread when done.
(maria uploads csv)
aj (infra-op): audit output: 3 instances from redwood-ml-legacy matched same reservation id as redwood-prod, charged as on-demand with premium flag.
maria (finance): filed internal ticket #FIN-2026-042 and cc'd cloud-ops. escalating to GCP support now.
billing-bot: GCP Support ticket created: 1234567890 — status: open. Expected initial response in 24-48 hrs.
rachel (finance-manager): Good — please add projected refund estimate and mark P1 if they confirm double-charge. keep synced. :thumbsup:
aj (infra-op): next steps for infra: audit all reservations vs project attachments, and add a daily check that flags reservation_id used by multiple projects. I'll PR the alert rule tomorrow.
sahil (eng-ml): I'll run a one-off cost-recompute using the billing export to produce a de-duplicated view so finance can see corrected numbers pending provider response.
maria (finance): Thanks all — I'll consolidate numbers and update backlog item.
(END)
